terms.gloss: an orchid; in Pliny a plant named for its paired roots
terms.comment: Pliny’s plant; the botanists kept the name for the type genus of the orchids, and Morgan–Owens gives it for the orchid.

phrases.latin: Orchis in fenestrā flōret; nōlī eam tangere.
phrases.english: The orchid is flowering on the windowsill; don’t touch it.

phrases.latin: Haec orchis in arbore nāscitur, nōn in terrā.
phrases.english: This orchid grows on a tree, not in the ground.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. flowers: orchid.
